title: Further European rate hikes 'very much dependent' on energy costs, Bundesbank chief tells CNBC
summary_full: Joachim Nagel told CNBC that a potential move in rates into restrictive territory was "very much dependent on how the energy prices evolve."
summary_public: Joachim Nagel told CNBC that a potential move in rates into restrictive territory was "very much dependent on how the energy prices evolve."
